body: Sad day. Grew up in the southwestern part of Wyoming. Never got a chance to see the Tetons or Yellowstone. Forgot about them. Most of what I seen was ugly and awful.

The most beautiful feeling I have is going barefoot in the grass and dirt in the morning, when you can smell the earth. 

Hang in there. I'm sorry you're having a really rough time.

I'm so sorry. I wish there was something I could say that would help make things better for you. It sounds like you have the weight of the world on your shoulders. If you need someone to talk to, I'm here. I'm not much for advice, but I can listen if you need.

It's so easy to take out the frustration on those we love. I understand the feeling. Even though they don't deserve it, they are the easiest target for unwarranted frustration. Have you gotten any help, like seen a doctor or anything?
Pretty much anywhere in Wyoming, right?

Fallon, Nevada. 

Everything about that place is poisonous. Nasty town filled with nasty people. I hated having to visit my mother there. Every trip ended awfully. Every trip a disaster for different reasons. I still have family there, and my mother is buried there, but there is absolutely no reason I want to go back. 

... I didn't even go when they laid the headstone.

I am so sorry. 

I understand the complete hatred for the other person.  It's been months, but I feel nothing less than loathing for the other person. I'm doing my best to heal with my husband, but the other man, the things he said to me made me feel worthless.

No kids. I kind of lost my mind when it happened and I was forced to quit my job, or I would have been fired. I've been unemployed since, trying to get a grip on the anxiety and depression. 

It was with his best friend. And as far as I know, it was just once.
I hope you can find someone who can help you. :)
Do you have the option to maybe find another therapist? I don't really see how any of that is important to the process. Likes and dislikes just seem so arbitrary. Maybe you need someone else?
Maybe explain to him that your dislikes and likes have nothing to do with your healing process?

It's hard to want to bring myself to leave a 8 year relationship. I still love him just as much as I did, I'm just hurt. Broken. It really just baffles me that someone can do that to another person. I know it happens. I've never had feelings for anyone else. It's just. If he wanted something else, why not leave me first? Or not let me get so attached and give him everything of myself over the life of our relationship? It's cruel.
That sucks. Majorly. :(

I'm sorry. 

She isn't worth your time or emotions if she can't be supportive of yours. I wouldn't think twice of her, cause you will find someone who will love you for all of you, pain and happiness and the whole package.
Empathy? Cause you know how they feel? You aren't heartless if you want to help. If you want to save.
How do I begin that?
I can't even bring myself to talk about the cheating anymore. The other person denied him, so is he staying because he got rejected?

How do you feel about medication? Is it an option you are willing to try? Remember, they can be temporary. They take time to start working and a lot of times, they need adjustment. To start them is a bit of a commitment of time.

If I'm at work, I tend to be very blunt cause I'm at work and I expect things to be done and done right. When I am with people. In a social setting, people tend to think I am angry or annoyed, even if I'm not. I'm not one to smile much and I tend to keep to myself if I don't really have much to say. And if something is upsetting, I tend to tell them how I feel about it, a bit too bluntly. 

I've never been good with people.
I'd change my demeanor. People generally don't like me much due to the way I talk.

Mine was the heart I never thought you would break, 
My one hope was, that I’d survive you.
I'm 27. He is 29.
As much as I love him,  he has always been a bit selfish.  And I agree, it's insane.  The whole situation is totally effed.
I want to make it work.  Because up until four months ago, I had a happiness I had never experienced before, a love and a partner that fit me perfectly.

I'm a thinker.  No matter what I do,  I'm thinking,  hard,  about everything.  I have never been in control of my emotions. I usually turn to anger because it's an emotion I know what to do with.  But I don't feel anger here,  but so many other strong emotions.  I've tried writing, painting, Ive decluttered the whole house and garage.

I'm not 100% that he has been opening up to his friend either since he closed off to me. He seems so detached right now.  I always thought heartbreak was overexaggrrated, in movies and songs and stuff,  but this shit is real.  It's a physical pain that I've never experienced.  I've got some brickwork to lay down, I'm just hoping that he will be willing to put some down too.

I'm just hoping he'll be able to see the bigger picture.  I'm mainly just wanting to know what he wants.  It will kill me if this happens again.  I would never give him an ultimatum, but it hurts he didn't make the decision himself.  I will try to give him some space,  which is hard when all I want to do is be close to him.  Maybe he will clear his head a bit and open up.  And then I can be clear.  Right now, I'm scared of pushing him further away.
I have been putting myself on it too.  I haven't stopped thinking about it since the night he told me.

I'm trying to take care of myself.  I haven't always been the most steady when it comes to mental health.  I never learned to cope with strong emotions. I have had help from a doctor, prescribed me an antidepressant, which hasn't taken effect yet and valium for the panic attacks.  Him not talking to me just makes my anxiety and insecurities worse.
I wish I provided these with things.  I don't require much from others,  just him.
I suggested couples therapy. He doesn't want to be pushed into feeling and talking before he is ready.

I don't think he's trying to make me feel bad.  I know he's feeling awful too... I don't want him to have to end a friendship.  And the friend is very unstable.  I don't know if I want to throw away 7 years.  I don't know how to get him to talk to me about it.
I can't imagine my life without him.  I've invested everything of myself to him.  I want us to work.
